lead.headline: Democrats pick a progressive in Minnesota, a centrist in Wisconsin
lead.dek: Trump's endorsements carried Wisconsin and South Carolina but lost Minnesota's governor primary.
body: Democratic primary voters in six states divided between the party's left and its center Tuesday, nominating Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan for the U.S. Senate in Minnesota while narrowly rejecting a democratic socialist for governor in Wisconsin.

Flanagan, 46, beat Rep. Angie Craig, who held the fundraising edge, running with endorsements from Sens. Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren. Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley edged state Rep. Francesca Hong in Wisconsin, and Connecticut Democrats replaced 14-term Rep. John Larson with Luke Bronin.
Trump's endorsements ran uneven. Rep. Tom Tiffany took the Republican nomination for Wisconsin governor, but MyPillow founder Mike Lindell lost Minnesota's to House Speaker Lisa Demuth.

briefs.headline: FBI confirms cyberattacks on water systems in seven states
briefs.summary: More than 30 Minnesota systems were hit in late July, among them Braham, where a pump failure threatened supply for 1,700 people.

briefs.headline: Russia frees a former Marine held since 2022
briefs.summary: Trump said Robert Gilman, 32, was released with no exchange and flown to Andrews Air Force Base on Wednesday, hospitalized since early July.

briefs.headline: Storms cut power to nearly 1 million in four states
briefs.summary: Winds topping 80 mph and three suspected tornadoes crossed Illinois, Indiana, Ohio and Kentucky on Tuesday. Two people died.

briefs.headline: Colombia's quake toll passes 180 as rescues go on
briefs.summary: Authorities reported at least 181 dead, 2,595 injured and 195 missing Wednesday; a civilian database put the missing near 4,000.

briefs.headline: Overloaded ferry capsizes on Lake Kariba, killing 15
briefs.summary: Zimbabwe's Civil Protection Unit said 119 people were aboard a vessel rated for 90. Rescuers pulled 77 onto an island; 27 are missing.

briefs.headline: Putin threatens to seize European ships in tanker fight
briefs.summary: At naval drills off Sakhalin, Putin called European seizures of sanctioned Russian tankers piracy and said Moscow would respond in kind.

briefs.headline: Flash flooding and 20,500 outages follow Tuesday storms
briefs.summary: Flash flood warnings covered Kanawha, Roane, Jackson, Mason and Putnam counties, and Appalachian Power counted about 20,500 customers out by 9 p.m.

briefs.headline: PEIA tells lawmakers it is $67M ahead of projections
briefs.summary: Director Brent Wolfingbarger said the plan should close 2026 with a $345 million reserve and premiums rising less than the 3% anticipated.

regional.item: A falling tree killed a motorcyclist at Pinch on Tuesday evening, pulling down power lines that caught fire.

away.item: Democrats nominated Amanda Janoo for governor Tuesday; Molly Gray won the lieutenant governor primary.

briefs.headline: Vikings name Kyler Murray their Week 1 starter
briefs.summary: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Tuesday that Murray, 29, beat out 2024 first-round pick J.J. McCarthy two weeks into camp.

briefs.headline: NBA opens Oct. 20 with a Knicks banner ceremony
briefs.summary: The league released its 1,230-game schedule Tuesday. New York raises its first title banner since 1973 against Philadelphia.

briefs.headline: Cell waste drives both childhood dementia and Alzheimer's
briefs.summary: Overloaded waste sacs in the brain's immune cells flip a genetic switch shared by Sanfilippo syndrome type A and Alzheimer's, Immunity reports.

briefs.headline: Mosquito species pick different people, study finds
briefs.summary: Researchers tested 119 volunteers in Miami against three species and found none was highly attractive to all three.
